commands: prepare a fresh task-owned project copy with npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
npm run check and npm run typecheck against the fresh locked install
curl --noproxy '*' exact literal-loopback /api/version and /api/tags tuple checks
repeat the prepared-tree tar-stream SHA-256 after sandboxed startup and require byte identity

result.projectShape: one pinned application, SDK archive, package lock, agent graph, and recording-tool serves both deterministic and live-model profiles; no duplicate project or engine was added
result.profile: the live profile passed the closed v1 Go parser and selects only the compiled local Ollama descriptor with zero monetary cost
result.childAuthority: the sandboxed project received a random loopback relay URL and one-time obx_relay bearer; no 127.0.0.1:11434 destination, upstream inspection route, external provider credential, or caller-selected model entered the child environment
result.relayAuthority: the parent relay observed exact server/model identity before exposing its child listener and retains the sole upstream URL, route, method, model, tool, prompt, token, and no-redirect authority
result.application: the same Mastra language-model seam builds the relay's closed native Ollama tool request and maps only one validated recording-tool response into the existing SDK-wrapped tool path
result.startup: five fresh service/sandbox/project repetitions reached SDK authentication and GET /health readiness; the relay received zero chat requests during startup

cleanup.processes: each sandboxed Node process group terminated after readiness
cleanup.listeners: receiver, fixture, sink, and relay listeners closed after each repetition
cleanup.ollama: ollama ps was empty; startup performed identity inspection only and did not load the model
cleanup.preparedProject: before/after prepared-tree digests matched; the task directory is moved to Trash after final verification

limits: This task proves the live variant's code, profile, relay confinement, exact tuple preflight, SDK startup, and readiness. It deliberately does not claim a model inference or security outcome.
The first end-to-end local-model stimulus and effect correlation belongs to SE-05-06/SE-05-07 after the SE-05-04 orchestration and SE-05-05 SDK readiness gates exist.
The local Ollama server is pre-existing and not run-owned; no external provider, paid API, provider credential, production OpenBox coordinate, Docker, or external control plane was used.
